This '''[[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed''' '''lightsaber''' was created and used by [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Kyle Katarn]] after he joined the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. He later left it behind when he abandoned the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], only to take it up again during the [[Empire Reborn]] crisis. This lightsaber had a longer hilt and two handgrips.

==History==
===Creation and Disuse===
Sometime after his fall to the dark side on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="MOTS" /> Katarn joined the Jedi Praxeum and built his own lightsaber to replace the one he had taken from the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Yun]]. Despite his attendance at the Praxeum&mdash;which he started due to fear of falling to the dark side again&mdash;Katarn became worried when both [[Gantoris]] and [[Kyp Durron]] turned to the dark side. Unwilling to risk turning again, Katarn gave his lightsaber to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and left the Praxeum, becoming a mercenary again, alongside his partner, [[Jan Ors]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

===Empire Reborn crisis===
====Return to the Praxeum====
However, when Dark Jedi [[Desann]] supposedly killed Jan during a mission to [[Artus Prime]], Kyle became vengeful and returned to the Praxeum to get his lightsaber back. Skywalker told him that to do so, he would have to go through the Praxeum's exercise course to retrieve it. When Katarn succeeded, he set off to find Jan.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />But not before Luke expressed his concern for Kyle’s emotional state and correctly surmised that he visited the Valley of the Jedi to increase his power.

====Nar Shaddaa====
Katarn's lightsaber would continue to serve him on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where he used it to intimidate a [[Baldarek|bartender]] into telling him where crime lord [[Reelo Baruk]] was. The bartender signaled the cantina's mercenaries, and they attacked Katarn. Using only his lightsaber, Katarn managed to defeat the mercenaries and retrieve his weapons&mdash;including his modified [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]]. He then spoke to the bartender again, who told him that Baruk was running a scrap yard. Fighting through the scrap yard, Katarn rescued [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and defeated Baruk.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

====Cloud City====
Katarn then traveled to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], which Desann's forces were attempting to capture. Fighting through the underlevels of the city, Katarn encountered a [[Reborn]]&mdash;a Dark Jedi fueled with the power of the [[Valley of the Jedi]]. Katarn defeated the Reborn, along with many more of the Force sensitives throughout the city, until he reached [[Tavion Axmis]], Desann's apprentice. Katarn bested her and threatened to kill her, but relented and let her go when Tavion told him that Jan was still alive.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

====Cairn and the ''Doomgiver''====
[[File:Rebornpwned4.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Katarn duels a pair of [[Reborn]].]]
Katarn snuck aboard a freighter to the [[Lenico Belt]], where Admiral [[Galak Fyyar]] had a mining operation. There, Katarn met Skywalker, who was disturbed by Kyle's discovery that Desann was mining [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]&mdash;a lightsaber-resistant material. Together, Katarn and Skywalker fought off a team of Reborn, then split up. Before departing aboard Fyyar's ship, the ''[[Doomgiver]]'', Katarn witnessed a duel between Skywalker and Desann.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

Aboard the ''Doomgiver'', Katarn signaled [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], then dueled a group of Desann's [[Shadowtrooper]]s, their armor lined with cortosis. Following this encounter, he rescued Jan, and the pair split up&mdash;Katarn headed for the shield generator and Jan for the escape pods. After disabling the generator, Katarn dueled Fyyar, who was defeated.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

====Yavin 4====
[[File:MediumStyle.jpg|thumb|right|194x194px|Katarn using the saber in [[Medium style]].]]
Katarn and Jan landed on Yavin and Katarn fought toward the Praxeum, defeating many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Wetland assault stormtrooper|swamptroopers]], along with several more Shadowtroopers. Once inside the Praxeum, Katarn assisted [[Unidentified Jedi (New Jedi Order)|several]] [[Jedi Trainer|Jedi]] [[Unidentified Jedi student|students]] in battling Reborn and Shadow troopers. Finally, Katarn reached Desann, and the two engaged in a duel. In the end, Desann was slain, and his Reborn rounded up. Though Skywalker offered to take Katarn's lightsaber back, Katarn said he would hold onto it for a while.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

====Alzoc III====
Shortly thereafter, Katarn and Jan investigated an outpost on [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], where Katarn fought another Reborn. After the mission was complete, Katarn returned to the hangar and found Jan surrounded by Imperials. After killing the stormtroopers, Katarn confronted the officer, who threatened to kill Jan. Jan, however, took the Imperial by surprise, and both she and Katarn escaped Alzoc III.<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hilt of Kyle Katarn's third lightsaber is able to be used in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'' multiplayer, where it uses the name Katarn, after its owner. The hilt is not available without cheats or modifications in single player, however.
